decisions.reason: The date-control scope expansion does not necessarily change click-to-clear placeholder behavior; the source's placeholder clauses are already represented by separate same-message Events.
Extending the reusable date control does not change the checklist-and-dropdown configuration.
Text wrapping and column stability are independent of the date-control scope expansion and are already established by a separate clause in the source message.
Applying the Board Seminar date functionality to other templates does not alter multiline input behavior.
The label and help-text requirement already applies to every interactive field, and the source does not change its content or scope.
The date-control scope expansion does not change the requirement to keep visible instructional text in editable fields.
The source decision concerns reuse of date functionality, not preservation of Title-field formatting during interaction.
Reusing the existing date functionality in additional templates does not necessarily modify the broader field implementation architecture.
The date placeholder text is already defined for interactive date fields, and the source does not introduce new wording or change the localization requirement.
Continuous-text return spacing is independent of the date-control scope expansion and is addressed by a separate clause in the source message.
Adding reusable date functionality to the Board Meeting template does not change Item and Title alignment; the alignment issue is separately represented.
The date-control scope expansion has no effect on Enter-key bullet creation behavior.
